title: Understanding the Role of λ
text: In the context of ridge regression, the regularization parameter λ is used to control the complexity of the model. It is not a fixed quantity in the true model that generates X and Y.

title: λ in Ridge Regression
text: The regularization parameter λ is chosen during the model training process to prevent overfitting. It is not a part of the true model that generates the data.

title: Determine if λ is Fixed
text: Consider whether λ is a parameter that is set before the data is generated or if it is chosen during the model fitting process.
